instruction.text: Match the sound devices to their description.

atoms.a: successive words share the same initial letter
a repetition of similar vowel sounds in nearby words
a word imitates the sound that it is describing
Alliteration must occur at the beginning of every word in a sentence.

wrong.text:
Not every word needs to start with the same consonant.

e.g. She sells seashells by the shore.
wrong.sound: Not every word needs to start with the same consonant. She sells seashells by the shore.

atoms.a: Assonance focuses on the repetition of consonant sounds.

wrong.text: Assonance focuses on the repetition of vowel sounds.

atoms.a: Onomatopoeia creates auditory imagery through sound imitation.
